policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="deploymentName" value="@{
      var mp = context.Request.MatchedParameters;
      if (mp != null && mp.ContainsKey("deployment") && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(mp["deployment"])) { return mp["deployment"]; }
      try {
        var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        if (body != null && body["model"] != null) { return body["model"].ToString(); }
      } catch { }
      return "mock-model";
    }" />
    <set-variable name="isStream" value="@{
      try {
        var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        if (body != null && body["stream"] != null && body["stream"].Type == JTokenType.Boolean) { return (bool)body["stream"]; }
      } catch { }
      return false;
    }" />

          @{
            var id = "chatcmpl-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 24);
            var created = (string)context.Variables["createdTs"];
            var model = (string)context.Variables["deploymentName"];
            var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            sb.Append("data: {\"id\":\"").Append(id).Append("\",\"object\":\"chat.completion.chunk\",\"created\":").Append(created).Append(",\"model\":\"").Append(model).Append("\",\"system_fingerprint\":\"fp_mock\",\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"delta\":{\"role\":\"assistant\",\"content\":\"\"},\"finish_reason\":null,\"content_filter_results\":{}}]}\n\n");
            var chunks = new[] { "I'm ", "an ", "LLM ", "mock" };
            foreach (var w in chunks) {
              sb.Append("data: {\"id\":\"").Append(id).Append("\",\"object\":\"chat.completion.chunk\",\"created\":").Append(created).Append(",\"model\":\"").Append(model).Append("\",\"system_fingerprint\":\"fp_mock\",\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"delta\":{\"content\":\"").Append(w).Append("\"},\"finish_reason\":null,\"content_filter_results\":{\"hate\":{\"filtered\":false,\"severity\":\"safe\"},\"self_harm\":{\"filtered\":false,\"severity\":\"safe\"},\"sexual\":{\"filtered\":false,\"severity\":\"safe\"},\"violence\":{\"filtered\":false,\"severity\":\"safe\"}}}]}\n\n");
            }
            sb.Append("data: {\"id\":\"").Append(id).Append("\",\"object\":\"chat.completion.chunk\",\"created\":").Append(created).Append(",\"model\":\"").Append(model).Append("\",\"system_fingerprint\":\"fp_mock\",\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"delta\":{},\"finish_reason\":\"stop\",\"content_filter_results\":{}}],\"usage\":{\"prompt_tokens\":10,\"completion_tokens\":5,\"total_tokens\":15}}\n\n");
            sb.Append("data: [DONE]\n\n");
            return sb.ToString();
          }

          @{
            var id = "chatcmpl-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 24);
            var created = long.Parse((string)context.Variables["createdTs"]);
            var model = (string)context.Variables["deploymentName"];
            var payload = new JObject {
              ["id"] = id,
              ["object"] = "chat.completion",
              ["created"] = created,
              ["model"] = model,
              ["system_fingerprint"] = "fp_mock",
              ["prompt_filter_results"] = new JArray(new JObject {
                ["prompt_index"] = 0,
                ["content_filter_results"] = new JObject {
                  ["hate"] = new JObject { ["filtered"] = false, ["severity"] = "safe" },
                  ["self_harm"] = new JObject { ["filtered"] = false, ["severity"] = "safe" },
                  ["sexual"] = new JObject { ["filtered"] = false, ["severity"] = "safe" },
                  ["violence"] = new JObject { ["filtered"] = false, ["severity"] = "safe" }
                }
              }),
              ["choices"] = new JArray(new JObject {
                ["index"] = 0,
                ["message"] = new JObject {
                  ["role"] = "assistant",
                  ["content"] = "I'm an LLM mock"
                },
                ["finish_reason"] = "stop",
                ["content_filter_results"] = new JObject {
                  ["hate"] = new JObject { ["filtered"] = false, ["severity"] = "safe" },
                  ["self_harm"] = new JObject { ["filtered"] = false, ["severity"] = "safe" },
                  ["sexual"] = new JObject { ["filtered"] = false, ["severity"] = "safe" },
                  ["violence"] = new JObject { ["filtered"] = false, ["severity"] = "safe" }
                }
              }),
              ["usage"] = new JObject {
                ["prompt_tokens"] = 10,
                ["completion_tokens"] = 5,
                ["total_tokens"] = 15
              }
            };
            return payload.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
          }
